accounts.name: host_user

accounts.name: caller
docs: Any signer — does NOT need to own `target_user`.

accounts.name: target_user
docs: The User PDA being cleaned up. The seeds aren't reverified here
(no fixed `seeds = [...]` constraint) because the PDA could belong
to any wallet. The account-level discriminator + the `expires_at`
guard inside the handler are the only authentication needed.

errors.name: NotInRoom
errors.msg: User is not in a room

errors.name: RoomMismatch
errors.msg: User room does not match provided room

errors.name: SlotNotExpired
errors.msg: Connect slot has not expired yet

errors.name: ZeroDeposit
errors.msg: Deposit amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ZeroExpiry
errors.msg: Expires-in seconds must be greater than zero

errors.msg: Host is still active — cannot clean up

errors.msg: Deposit does not match the value stored on the Room

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: Caller does not have enough lamports to cover the deposit

errors.name: NotStaleEnough
errors.msg: Target user is not stale enough to clean up

fields.name: viewer
docs: Viewer wallet (set when viewer claims slot)

fields.name: offer_data
docs: Host's encrypted offer SDP (encrypted with passphrase)

fields.name: host_rent_paid
docs: Sum of host's rent contribution (init rent + write_offer top-ups).

fields.name: viewer_rent_paid
docs: Sum of viewer's rent contribution (write_answer top-ups).

fields.name: access_price
docs: Access price snapshot (lamports). Copied from room.price_per_session

fields.name: service_wallet
docs: Receives TURN fees and signal fees

fields.name: heartbeat_ttl
docs: Seconds before viewer expires without heartbeat (default 300)

fields.name: min_heartbeat_interval
docs: Minimum seconds between heartbeats (rate limit, default 60)

fields.name: deposit_lamports
docs: ConnectSlot deposit set by the host at room creation. Both the host's
this exact value — guards against malicious clients submitting trivial
deposits and skipping the WebRTC escrow.

fields.name: price_per_session
docs: Phase 1 PfA flat-rate price per ConnectSlot session (lamports).
Set at create_room. 0 = free room (default). Read at claim_connect_slot

fields.name: room
docs: Room PDA if in a room (Pubkey::default() if Idle)

fields.name: connected_to
docs: Who this user is connected to

fields.name: turn_expires_at
docs: TURN access expiry (0 = no active TURN)
